universe.negative_universe_scope: Fixed PDF-grounded bounded controls; not a statistical population of all absent claims.

duplication.calculation_en: (eligible generated occurrences - unique raw semantic classes) / eligible generated occurrences; distinct from effective canonical source-proposition scoring.

metric_interpretation: A fully enumerated canonical four-cell universe with bounded TN. No unsupported-only FP was certified on this bounded review, but reverse support for many generated classes remains unverified; provisional Precision 100% must not be described as actual perfect precision. Duplicate is computed separately on raw semantic-class occurrences. The TP review verifies original lines, but does not certify every semantic bridge.

generated_reverse_quote_fragment_checks.interpretation: Literal/partial quote matching is only an evidence locator check; it is not semantic entailment verification.
